data.title: Quantum Cyber Appoints New Chief Financial Officer
data.description:
An update from Quantum Cyber ( (QUCY) ) is now available.

Quantum Cyber N.V. said on November 20, 2026, that William Caragol resigned as chief financial officer, effective that day. The board appointed David Caplon, who had been the company’s Controller since June 2026, as chief financial officer, principal financial officer and principal accounting officer.

In connection with the appointment, Caplon entered into an executive employment agreement providing for a $270,000 annualized base salary, a target annual cash bonus equal to 100% of base salary and eligibility for annual equity awards under stated terms. He was also granted a 170,000-share option under the company’s 2025 Omnibus Incentive Plan, subject to continued employment and vesting in 18 substantially equal monthly installments.

data.title: Alps Group Regains Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Compliance
data.description:
ALPS Group ( (ALPS) ) just unveiled an update.

On November 20, 2026, Alps Group said Nasdaq confirmed that it had regained compliance with the $1 minimum bid-price requirement for continued listing on The Nasdaq Global Market. The company said its closing bid price was $1 or greater for 10 consecutive business days from November 9 through November 20, 2026.

The announcement followed a 1-for-5 share consolidation, with post-consolidation trading beginning November 9, and a November 16 Nasdaq notice saying the shares faced delisting after the company failed to regain compliance by November 11. Nasdaq said the matter was closed, and the ordinary shares continued trading under the symbol ALPS.

data.title: PMV Pharmaceuticals Presents Updated PYNNACLE Trial Data
data.description:
PMV Pharmaceuticals ( (PMVP) ) just unveiled an announcement.

On November 20, 2026, PMV Pharmaceuticals reported updated data from the pivotal Phase 2 portion of the PYNNACLE trial, which evaluated rezatapopt monotherapy in patients with TP53 Y220C-mutated advanced solid tumors. The data were presented that day as a late-breaking oral presentation at ENA 2026 in Barcelona, Spain.

In 65 platinum-resistant or refractory ovarian cancer patients who had received prior standard care, investigator-assessed overall response rate was 48%, median duration of response was 10.4 months and disease control rate was 83%. Among 168 evaluable patients across all cohorts, overall response rate was 36% and median duration of response was 8.1 months; responses were observed across eight tumor types, while treatment-related adverse events were mostly Grade 1 or 2 and 11 patients discontinued treatment because of them.

data.title: GSK Transfers 22,000,000 Treasury Shares to Procure 11,000,000 ADRs
data.description:
GlaxoSmithKline ( (GSK) ) has provided an update.

GSK is a global biopharma company whose stated purpose is to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

On November 20, 2026, GSK transferred 22,000,000 treasury-held ordinary shares to JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., the depositary for its American depositary receipts programme, to procure the issuance and transfer of 11,000,000 ADRs to the GlaxoSmithKline (US) Trust. The ADRs were to be used to satisfy awards under the Deferred Annual Bonus Plan, Performance Share Plan and Share Value Plan.

The consideration received was $47.82 per ADR, or $23.91 per ordinary share, and was funded by a contribution to the Trust from GlaxoSmithKline LLC. Following the transfer, GSK will hold 248,881,064 ordinary shares in treasury and have 4,067,451,066 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares; treasury shares will represent 6.12% of voting rights.

data.title: Fitness Champs Closes Approximately $5 Million Public Offering
data.description:
Fitness Champs Holdings Limited ( (FCHL) ) has issued an update.

Fitness Champs Holdings Limited is a Singapore aquatic sports education provider offering swimming lessons for children and adults, including ladies-only classes, competitive swimming and lifesaving. Its market focus includes Singapore public schools through the Ministry of Education’s SwimSafer program and private lessons under the Fitness Champs brand.

On November 20, 2026, the company announced the closing of a best-efforts public offering expected to generate approximately $5 million in gross proceeds before fees and expenses. The offering comprised 14,285,715 units containing a Class A ordinary share or pre-funded warrant and a warrant; if all warrants were exercised under the zero-exercise-price option, the company would issue 214,285,725 shares without additional consideration.

The company said it believed the offering proceeds raised stockholders’ equity above Nasdaq’s $2.5 million requirement, addressing a deficiency first reported on May 26, 2026. Nasdaq’s final compliance determination remained subject to review, and the company could face delisting if it failed to demonstrate compliance in a future periodic report.
